articles.essence: Apple's ad introducing its new HomeView smart display is a little unusual. It's fast-paced and unruly, depicting a family of five as they rush through the morning routine.

articles.title: OpenAI employee arrested for allegedly planting a bug in a conference room
articles.essence: An OpenAI engineer was arrested after the company said it discovered a "sophisticated recording device" hidden in one of its offices. The employee was identified as Abdulrahman Alfozan, a 35-year-old Saudi national.

articles.title: It looks like Apple Music is getting a new icon
